schemaFaqs.answer: Puede plantear dudas sobre un diagnóstico, un tratamiento o sus informes. Esta consulta general ayuda a aclarar preguntas pendientes; si necesita la valoración de un especialista concreto, el médico puede orientarle.

schemaFaqs.question: Is this only a prescription renewal appointment?
schemaFaqs.answer: No. You can review symptoms, test results and how you are tolerating treatment. The doctor decides whether monitoring, tests or specialist assessment are needed; a prescription is not guaranteed.

schemaFaqs.question: Which languages can I use during the appointment?
schemaFaqs.answer: The doctors available for this service consult in Romanian and English. Check the language and available time when booking; the language of this page does not change the languages the doctor speaks.

schemaFaqs.question: What should I have ready?
schemaFaqs.answer: Note your symptoms, when they started and any treatment you take. Keep relevant test results and medical letters nearby if you have them.

schemaFaqs.question: What if I need a physical examination?
schemaFaqs.answer: The doctor may recommend an in-person assessment if the video discussion and records are not enough. An online consultation does not replace emergency care. For a medical emergency, call 112. Do not wait for an online appointment.

It requires a doctor who understands your case, monitors your progress, adjusts your management when things change, and helps you navigate the broader healthcare system when specialist input is needed.In Romania, continuity of chronic disease management is one of the most significant gaps in both the public and private healthcare systems. Short consultation times, fragmented care between specialists, and limited primary care access outside major cities all contribute to chronic conditions that are inadequately monitored and managed.Our doctors, registered with the Romanian College of Physicians (CMR), provide ongoing GP-level chronic disease management by secure video call, the clinical continuity that should be the foundation of your long-term care. Same day, from anywhere in Romania, in English and Romanian.Chronic Disease Management vs Treatment Renewal: Understanding the DifferenceGlobal Health offers two separate services for patients with long-term conditions:Treatment Renewal is a single-consultation service for stable, established conditions. Your condition has not changed, your treatment is working, and you need your prescription renewed. One consultation, clear outcome.Chronic Disease Management provides ongoing GP-level care. Your doctor monitors your condition over time, adjusts management when needed, and coordinates investigations and specialist referrals.If your condition is stable and you need a prescription renewed, Treatment Renewal is appropriate. Choose Chronic Disease Management if you need ongoing support with your condition.Who This Service Is ForThis service is appropriate for adults with:A diagnosed chronic condition who want ongoing GP-level managementA long-term condition that is not well controlled and needs active clinical reviewMultiple co-existing conditions, for example diabetes with hypertension and dyslipidaemia, that require coordinated managementA chronic condition recently diagnosed in Romania that they want structured and managed with continuityA long-term condition managed in another country that they are continuing now that they are living in RomaniaA need for ongoing investigation monitoring, regular blood tests, HbA1c monitoring, thyroid function tracking, coordinated through a GP who knows their caseA chronic condition where lifestyle optimisation alongside medication management would improve outcomesAnyone in Romania, Romanian nationals, expats, international residents, who wants structured, ongoing chronic disease management without waiting weeks for a clinic appointmentWhy Continuity MattersChronic disease changes. Blood pressure that was controlled can rise. HbA1c that was stable can drift. A medication that worked can become less effective over time. A new symptom can indicate a complication or a need to reconsider the management plan.A doctor who monitors you over time can review patterns and changes across consultations, alongside your current symptoms.The Romanian healthcare system, both public and private, tends towards reactive management of chronic conditions. Public system consultations are short, specialists manage their specific organ system without coordinating with the broader picture, and primary care follow-up between specialist appointments is often absent. The result is that patients with multiple chronic conditions frequently fall through the gaps between providers.This service provides a GP who reviews your conditions together and coordinates your Management IncludesRegular clinical reviews. Your doctor conducts structured clinical reviews at appropriate intervals for your condition, assessing symptom control, treatment response, side effects, any new developments, and overall wellbeing. The frequency is determined by your condition and clinical need.Monitoring coordination. Your doctor issues investigation requests for regular monitoring, blood tests, HbA1c, thyroid function, lipid panels, renal function, and other condition-specific investigations, and reviews results with you in a follow-up consultation.Medication management. Your doctor reviews your medication at each clinical review, assessing efficacy, tolerability, and whether adjustment is needed based on current clinical findings and monitoring results.Lifestyle and self-management support. Evidence-based advice on diet, physical activity, weight management, smoking cessation, and alcohol moderation, tailored to your specific condition and how lifestyle factors interact with your clinical management.Specialist liaison and referral. When specialist input is needed, cardiology, endocrinology, pulmonology, rheumatology, gastroenterology, or other specialties, your doctor coordinates the referral, provides a comprehensive referral letter, and maintains the clinical relationship as your GP during and after specialist involvement.Electronic prescription: where clinically appropriate. When clinically indicated at each review, your doctor issues an electronic prescription through the Romanian Electronic Prescription System (SIPE). You present it at any pharmacy of your choice in Romania.Note: Special-regime prescriptions covering certain controlled and high-risk medications cannot be transmitted electronically under Romanian law. Your doctor advises if this applies to your situation.Clinical continuity. Because your doctor knows your case over time, clinical decisions are made in the context of your full history, not just the presenting complaint in a single consultation.Chronic Disease Management and the Romanian Healthcare SystemRomania's public system provides chronic disease management through registered family doctors, but only for patients who are registered and in areas where family doctors are available. Approximately one in three Romanian villages has no GP, making public system chronic disease management inaccessible for a significant portion of the population.In the private sector, chronic disease management is available but fragmented. Specialist appointments are accessible without referral, but coordination between specialists, and between specialists and a GP, is inconsistent. Patients with multiple conditions frequently manage their own coordination between providers, without a doctor who holds the full picture.Global Health provides this coordinating layer. Your CMR-registered doctor monitors your condition over time, coordinates your investigations and specialist referrals, adjusts your management when needed, and maintains the clinical continuity that makes chronic disease management genuinely effective.If you are eligible for the Romanian public health system and have a registered family doctor, this service works alongside, not instead of, your existing care. schemaFaqs.question: ¿La consulta sirve solo para renovar una receta?

schemaFaqs.answer: Anote sus síntomas, cuándo empezaron y los tratamientos que sigue. Tenga a mano los resultados y los informes médicos relacionados, si los tiene.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Y si necesito una exploración presencial?
schemaFaqs.answer: El médico puede recomendar una valoración presencial si la videollamada y los informes no son suficientes. La consulta online no sustituye la atención de urgencias. En una emergencia médica, llame al 112. No espere a una cita online.

body: ++All consultationsOnline consultationTests and referral adviceMedical letters, recommendations for tests, and referrals to specialists. Our licensed CMR doctors can assess the situation and issue the relevant clinical documentation when indicated.Registered doctors · RomaniaSecure video consultationConfidential & GDPR-compliantClinically reviewed by Dr Robert Gabriel Brindus· Colegiul Medicilor din România | 152462Book online160 leiper consultation20-minute appointmentDoctor registered in RomaniaInstant confirmation by emailConsultation summary includedSchedule the consultationSecure checkout · payments processed by StripeAbout this serviceNeed to see a specialist but do not have a referral letter? Need blood tests or imaging ordered by a doctor? Received results from a Romanian specialist that you want reviewed and explained clearly before deciding how to proceed?Our doctors, registered with the Romanian College of Physicians (CMR), issue clinical referral letters, blood test requests, and imaging requests following a full clinical assessment, giving you the documentation you need to access private specialist care and diagnostic investigations in Romania. Same day, from anywhere in the country, in English and Romanian.How Specialist Access Works in RomaniaRomania has a dual-track referral system: one for the public system and one for private care.Public system specialist access requires a referral from a registered family doctor (medic de familie) contracted with CNAS. Without this referral, public system specialist appointments are not reimbursed. Global Health cannot provide public system referrals. This requires a registered family doctor contracted with the Romanian public health insurance system.Private specialist access is available directly in most cases, you can book a private specialist appointment without a referral letter. However arriving at a specialist appointment without clinical context significantly reduces the quality of that first consultation. A specialist who receives a clear referral letter, describing your symptoms, relevant history, current medications, and the specific clinical question, conducts a more focused and efficient assessment.This service covers:Private referral letters: for private specialist consultations of your choiceBlood test requests: for private laboratory testing at collection points across RomaniaImaging requests: for private X-ray, ultrasound, MRI, or CTClinical summary letters: documenting your assessment and findings for continuity of careResults review: blood test results, imaging reports, or specialist letters reviewed and explained clearlyThis service does not cover:Public system specialist referrals: these require a family doctor contracted with CNASEmergency referrals: call 112 or go to the nearest emergency department immediatelyWho This Service Is ForThis consultation is appropriate for:Anyone who wants to see a private specialist in Romania and needs a clinical referral letter to accompany the appointmentPatients who need blood tests or imaging ordered by a doctor before booking privatelyPatients who have received results, from blood tests, imaging, or specialist consultations, that they want reviewed and explained clearlyPatients with a specific clinical concern they want formally assessed and documented before pursuing specialist carePatients who want a clinical summary letter, for insurance purposes, for a new doctor, or for continuity of carePatients who received a clinical letter or results in Romanian they want reviewed and contextualisedAnyone in Romania without a registered family doctor who needs clinical documentation to access private specialist careWhy a Referral Letter Adds ValueDirect access to private specialists in Romania is available in most cases without a referral letter. But a specialist who sees you without clinical context must start from scratch, and consultation time is spent gathering information that could have been communicated in writing in advance.A referral letter issued after clinical assessment contains everything the specialist needs before you walk in: your symptoms, their duration and severity, your current medications, relevant investigations already completed, and the specific clinical question you are asking the specialist to address. The specialist can immediately focus on the clinical problem rather than taking a basic history.The difference in the quality of that first specialist appointment, between arriving with a comprehensive referral letter versus arriving cold, is significant.Referral Letters: What They IncludeA referral letter issued by a Global Health doctor following clinical assessment includes:Patient details and relevant medical historyDescription of the presenting concern: symptoms, duration, severity, and relevant clinical findings from the video consultationCurrent medications and relevant investigations already completedSpecific clinical question for the specialist: what you are asking them to assess or advise onDegree of urgency (routine, soon, or urgent), based on clinical assessmentThe letter is issued in the language appropriate for the specialist, Romanian for Romanian-speaking specialists, English where needed. Discuss your preference with your doctor during the consultation.Blood Tests: What Can Be RequestedFollowing clinical assessment, your doctor can issue blood test requests for a wide range of investigations, including:Metabolic and cardiovascularFull blood count (FBC / hemoleucograma)Fasting glucose and HbA1cLipid panel: total cholesterol, LDL, HDL, triglyceridesRenal function: creatinine, eGFR, urea, electrolytesLiver function testsThyroid function: TSH, free T4, free T3Uric acidFerritin, iron studies, and B12/folateHormonal and reproductiveTestosterone panel: total and free testosterone, LH, FSH, SHBGFemale hormonal panel: oestradiol, FSH, LH, progesterone, AMHThyroid antibodies: anti-TPO, anti-thyroglobulinCortisolProlactinDHEA-SInflammatory and autoimmuneCRP and ESR (VSH)Rheumatoid factor and anti-CCPANA and ANCA panelsComplement levelsInfectious diseaseHIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C serologySTI panelsPost-vaccination immunity checks: hepatitis B, MMROtherVitamin DCoeliac screen: anti-tTG IgAPSA: prostate specific antigenHCG: pregnancy testAllergy panels: specific IgEBlood test requests are issued following clinical assessment. Your doctor advises on which tests are clinically indicated for your specific presentation.Accessing Private Blood Tests in RomaniaPrivate blood test collection points are widely available across Romania, in Bucharest and in major regional cities including Cluj-Napoca, Timișoara, Iași, Brașov, and Constanța. Private laboratory networks operate throughout the country with collection points in most towns.After your consultation, your doctor issues the investigation request and advises on where to go for collection based on your location. You book the collection appointment directly. No Romanian public health insurance is required for private blood tests. Results are typically available within 24 to 72 hours depending on the tests requested, though some specialist panels may take longer.Imaging RequestsWhere X-ray, ultrasound, MRI, or CT is clinically indicated following assessment, your doctor issues a formal imaging request. Private radiology is widely accessible in Romania. Major cities and most regional centres have private radiology facilities that accept direct booking with a doctor's request letter.Your doctor advises on the most appropriate imaging modality for your specific clinical question and the urgency of the investigation.Results ReviewReceived blood test results, imaging reports, or specialist letters that you want reviewed and explained clearly? schemaFaqs.question: Mohu požádat o konkrétní vyšetření nebo lékařskou zprávu?
schemaFaqs.answer: Můžete vysvětlit, proč vyšetření nebo dokument potřebujete, a předložit dosavadní doporučení. Lékař posoudí klinické odůvodnění. Soukromý dokument sám o sobě nezaručuje úhradu přes CNAS; ověřte podmínky u přijímajícího poskytovatele.

schemaFaqs.answer: Poznamenejte si příznaky, kdy začaly a jaké léky užíváte a jakou léčbu podstupujete. Pokud máte související výsledky vyšetření nebo lékařské zprávy, mějte je po ruce.

schemaFaqs.answer: Puede explicar por qué necesita la prueba o el documento y aportar recomendaciones previas. El médico decide qué está justificado clínicamente. Un documento privado no garantiza el reembolso de CNAS; consulte los requisitos del proveedor que lo recibe.

schemaFaqs.answer: Los médicos disponibles para este servicio atienden en rumano e inglés. Compruebe el idioma y la hora disponible al reservar. Que la página esté en español no significa que el médico hable español.

schemaFaqs.answer: Anote sus síntomas, cuándo empezaron y los tratamientos que sigue. Tenga a mano los resultados y los informes médicos relacionados, si los tiene.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Y si necesito una exploración presencial?

schemaFaqs.question: Jak se tato služba liší od konzultace s pediatrem?
schemaFaqs.answer: Jde o všeobecnou lékařskou konzultaci pro prvotní posouzení zdravotních potíží dítěte. Konzultace s pediatrem je samostatná služba. Lékař může podle potřeby doporučit odbornou péči nebo osobní vyšetření.

schemaFaqs.answer: Lékaři dostupní pro tuto službu konzultují v rumunštině a angličtině. Při rezervaci si ověřte jazyk a volný termín. Česká verze stránky neznamená, že lékař mluví česky.

schemaFaqs.question: How does this differ from the specialist pediatric appointment?
schemaFaqs.answer: This is a general medical consultation for an initial assessment of a child’s health concern. The specialist pediatric appointment is a separate service. The doctor can recommend specialist or in-person care where needed.

schemaFaqs.question: Which languages can I use during the appointment?
schemaFaqs.answer: The doctors available for this service consult in Romanian and English. Check the language and available time when booking; the language of this page does not change the languages the doctor speaks.

schemaFaqs.question: What should I have ready?
schemaFaqs.answer: Note your symptoms, when they started and any treatment you take. Keep relevant test results and medical letters nearby if you have them.

schemaFaqs.question: What if I need a physical examination?
schemaFaqs.answer: The doctor may recommend an in-person assessment if the video discussion and records are not enough. An online consultation does not replace emergency care. For a medical emergency, call 112. Do not wait for an online appointment.

body: ++All consultationsOnline consultationGeneral medical consultation for childrenQuick pediatric consultations and medical advice for children. Our licensed CMR doctors assess the child’s symptoms through a secure video consultation and provide clear recommendations for the next steps.Registered doctors · RomaniaSecure video consultationConfidential & GDPR-compliantClinically reviewed by Dr Robert Gabriel Brindus· Colegiul Medicilor din România | 152462Book online185 leiper consultation15-minute appointmentDoctor registered in RomaniaInstant confirmation by emailConsultation summary includedSchedule the consultationSecure checkout · payments processed by StripeAbout this serviceYour child is unwell and your next paediatrician appointment is days away. Or you are outside a major city where paediatric access is limited. Or it is Saturday evening and the clinic is closed. Or you want to understand your child's symptoms before deciding whether to go to the emergency department.Our doctors, registered with the Romanian College of Physicians (CMR), offer children's GP consultations by secure video call, assessing your child's symptoms, advising on management, and coordinating referral or further investigation where clinically indicated. Same day, from anywhere in Romania, in English and Romanian. A parent or guardian must be present throughout all consultations for children under 16.Who This Service Is ForThis consultation is appropriate for:Infants, children, and adolescents up to 18 years with acute or non-urgent health concernsParents without a registered paediatrician or family doctor for their childFamilies registered with a Romanian paediatrician who need clinical advice today, outside clinic hoursParents who need a child's symptoms assessed before deciding whether to go to the emergency departmentParents who received advice or documentation from a Romanian paediatrician and want it reviewed and explained clearlyAdolescents aged 16 and over who want to discuss a health concern directly with a doctorFamilies in rural areas or smaller cities where paediatric access is limitedThis service is for acute and non-urgent GP-level paediatric concerns. For paediatric emergencies, call 112 or go to the nearest emergency department immediately. Fever in infants under 3 months requires emergency assessment. Do not book a video consultation.Paediatric Healthcare in Romania: The Access GapRomania has one of the lowest ratios of paediatricians to children in the EU. In the public system, paediatric waiting times are long and clinic availability is heavily concentrated in county capitals and major cities. In rural areas and smaller towns, access to a paediatrician is often practically impossible without significant travel.In the private sector, paediatric care is better resourced in Bucharest and in some major regional cities, but English-speaking paediatricians are rare even in the private sector outside the capital.The result is that parents across Romania, Romanian nationals and expats alike, frequently face the same problem: a child who is unwell today, no available paediatric appointment, and a choice between an often overcrowded emergency department or waiting and hoping.This service addresses this gap directly. GP-level paediatric assessment by video call, same day, from anywhere in Romania, with clear guidance on whether in-person or emergency care is needed.Conditions Commonly AssessedRespiratory and ENTCommon cold, cough, and upper respiratory tract infectionsEar infections: otitis media and otitis externaSore throat and tonsillitisCroup: assessment and guidanceWheezing and mild asthma concernsSinusitis in older childrenFever and general illnessFever in children over 3 months: assessment, advice on management, and guidance on when to seek further careViral illnesses: roseola, hand foot and mouth, chickenpoxGastroenteritis: vomiting and diarrhoea, dehydration assessmentUrinary tract infections in childrenFatigue and general malaiseSkinRashes: assessment and guidance for parentsEczema in infants and children: flare management and ongoing adviceImpetigo and skin infections in childrenMolluscum contagiosumNappy rash and infant skin concernsAllergic skin reactionsGrowth, development, and behaviourParental concerns about developmental milestones: with referral for formal assessment where indicatedSleep difficulties in infants and young childrenFeeding concerns in infantsBehavioural concerns in school-age children: with referral where indicatedAdolescent health concerns: acne, menstrual health, mental wellbeing, weight concernsChronic condition managementAsthma management in children: review and ongoing guidanceEczema: ongoing management and flare reviewAllergies: assessment and management guidanceChronic abdominal pain in children: assessment and referral where indicatedOtherMedical documentation: school absence letters, fitness certificates, referral lettersReview of results or clinical letters from Romanian paediatricians: explained clearlyPre-travel health advice for childrenVaccination schedule queries: clarification and guidanceWhat Your Consultation IncludesFull paediatric clinical assessment. Your doctor takes a complete history of your child's symptoms: onset, duration, severity, associated symptoms, feeding and hydration status, relevant medical history, current medications, vaccination status, and family history where relevant. For younger children, the consultation is conducted with the parent describing symptoms and showing the child on video where relevant.Safety assessment. Every paediatric consultation includes assessment of whether the child's presentation requires emergency or urgent in-person care. Your doctor advises clearly and immediately if this is the case.Clear parental guidance. You leave the consultation knowing what is most likely happening with your child, what to do at home, what symptoms to watch for, what would prompt you to seek further care, and when to expect improvement. Parental confidence and knowledge is a clinical outcome in itself. A parent who understands what is happening with their child makes better decisions about when to seek further care.Electronic prescription: where clinically appropriate. When clinically indicated, your doctor issues an electronic prescription through the Romanian Electronic Prescription System (SIPE). You present it at any pharmacy of your choice in Romania.Note: Special-regime prescriptions covering certain medications cannot be transmitted electronically under Romanian law. Your doctor advises if this applies to your child's situation.Antibiotic prescription, where clinically indicated. Since 2024, all antibiotics in Romania require a doctor's prescription. For children with bacterial infections, ear infections, throat infections, urinary tract infections, and skin infections, your doctor assesses the presentation and prescribes the appropriate antibiotic where clinically justified.Referral and documentation. When referral to a Romanian paediatrician, specialist, or emergency department is needed, your doctor issues the relevant documentation on the same day, in English or Romanian as appropriate.When to Go to the Emergency Department: A Clear Guide for ParentsOne of the most common and most stressful decisions parents face is whether a child's condition warrants emergency care or whether careful monitoring at home is appropriate. This consultation helps you make that decision with clinical support, but some presentations require emergency care without waiting for a video consultation:Go to the emergency department immediately if your child has:Fever in an infant under 3 months. This is always an emergencyDifficulty breathing: any rapid, laboured, or noisy breathingA rash that does not fade when pressed with a glass: possible meningitis, call 112First seizure, or a seizure lasting more than 5 minutesLoss of consciousness or unresponsivenessSevere allergic reaction: swelling of lips, tongue, or throatA child who is deteriorating rapidlyPaediatric emergency departments in Romania:Spitalul Clinic de Urgență pentru Copii "Grigore Alexandrescu": Bucharest, dedicated children's emergency hospitalSpitalul Clinic de Urgență pentru Copii "Marie Curie": BucharestSpitalul Clinic de Urgență pentru Copii "Louis Țurcanu": TimișoaraSpitalul Clinic de Urgență pentru Copii: Cluj-NapocaOutside major cities: the nearest spital județean (county hospital) has a paediatric emergency departmentWhen in doubt, always go to the emergency department. It is always better to be seen and reassured than to wait at home with a deteriorating child.Important Information Before You BookA parent or guardian must be present throughout all consultations for children under 16, in accordance with Legea nr. 272/2004 privind protecția și promovarea drepturilor copiluluiFor adolescents aged 16 and over, the doctor assesses capacity to consent individually in accordance with Romanian medical and legal standardsFever in infants under 3 months is a medical emergency requiring immediate in-person assessment. Do not book a video consultation for this presentationRapidly deteriorating children: if your child is getting significantly worse while you are trying to book, go to the emergency department immediately rather than waiting for a consultationMandatory reporting: our clinical professionals are bound by Legea nr. 272/2004. neurological basis: assessment and referralFunctional neurological symptoms: assessment and management planningWhat Your Consultation IncludesSpecialist neurological assessment. Your neurologist takes a comprehensive history, symptom onset, character, progression, pattern, triggers, associated symptoms, previous investigations and their results, current medications and their effects, and relevant medical history. A limited neurological examination is conducted where possible by video, including observation of speech, facial symmetry, tremor, gait, and other assessable parameters.Investigation results review. If you have MRI, CT, EEG, or EMG results and want them reviewed and explained by a neurologist, bring these to your consultation. Your neurologist reviews the reports and imaging in full and explains the findings clearly: what they show, what they mean for your diagnosis, and what the implications are for management.Treatment review and adjustment. For patients with an established neurological diagnosis, your neurologist reviews your current treatment, assessing efficacy, tolerability, side effects, and whether adjustment or an alternative approach is warranted.Clinical management plan. Based on the assessment, your neurologist advises on the most appropriate next steps, which may include further investigation requests, referral for in-person specialist assessment or procedures, medication recommendations at the specialist's professional discretion, or structured monitoring and follow-up.Electronic prescription: where clinically appropriate. When clinically indicated, your neurologist issues an electronic prescription through SIPE. You present it at any pharmacy of your choice in Romania.Note: Special-regime prescriptions covering certain neurological medications cannot be transmitted electronically under Romanian law. Your neurologist advises if this applies to your situation.Specialist clinical documentation. Where clinically appropriate, your neurologist issues a written specialist assessment, documenting the clinical findings, diagnosis or differential diagnoses, and management recommendations, which can be shared with your GP, other specialists, or used for insurance purposes.Referral coordination. When in-person neurological assessment, specialist investigation, or multidisciplinary input is needed, your neurologist coordinates the referral on the same day.Neurology in Romania: The Access GapSpecialist neurology waiting times in Romania are among the longest of any specialty, particularly in the public system, where waiting times for a neurology outpatient appointment can extend to several months. schemaFaqs.question: ¿Cuándo puede ayudar la opinión de un pediatra?
schemaFaqs.answer: Puede consultar síntomas persistentes o repetidos, la evolución tras un tratamiento y dudas sobre el desarrollo de su hijo. El pediatra revisa los antecedentes y los informes y explica si necesita pruebas o exploración física.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿En qué idioma será la consulta?
schemaFaqs.answer: Los médicos disponibles para este servicio atienden en rumano e inglés. Compruebe el idioma y la hora disponible al reservar. Que la página esté en español no significa que el médico hable español.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Qué debo preparar?
schemaFaqs.answer: Anote sus síntomas, cuándo empezaron y los tratamientos que sigue. Tenga a mano los resultados y los informes médicos relacionados, si los tiene.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Y si necesito una exploración presencial?
schemaFaqs.answer: El médico puede recomendar una valoración presencial si la videollamada y los informes no son suficientes. La consulta online no sustituye la atención de urgencias. En una emergencia médica, llame al 112. No espere a una cita online.

Book Online pediatrician consultation in Romania

schemaFaqs.question: When might a pediatrician’s opinion help?
schemaFaqs.answer: You can discuss persistent or recurring symptoms, progress after treatment and questions about your child’s development. The pediatrician reviews the history and available records, then explains whether tests or a physical examination are needed.

schemaFaqs.question: Which languages can I use during the appointment?
schemaFaqs.answer: The doctors available for this service consult in Romanian and English. Check the language and available time when booking; the language of this page does not change the languages the doctor speaks.

schemaFaqs.question: What should I have ready?
schemaFaqs.answer: Note your symptoms, when they started and any treatment you take. Keep relevant test results and medical letters nearby if you have them.

schemaFaqs.question: What if I need a physical examination?
schemaFaqs.answer: The doctor may recommend an in-person assessment if the video discussion and records are not enough. An online consultation does not replace emergency care. For a medical emergency, call 112. Do not wait for an online appointment.

body: ++All specialist consultationsSpecialist careOnline pediatrician consultationSpecialist pediatric opinion and detailed evaluation for the child's health problems. Our CMR-authorized pediatrician offers video consultations for cases requiring in-depth clinical analysis.Registered doctors · RomaniaSecure video consultationConfidential & GDPR-compliantClinically reviewed by Dr Robert Gabriel Brindus· Colegiul Medicilor din România | 152462Book online185 leiper consultation15-minute appointmentDoctor registered in RomaniaInstant confirmation by emailConsultation summary includedSchedule the consultationSecure checkout · payments processed by StripeAbout this serviceSome child health concerns go beyond what a GP-level paediatric consultation can fully address. A complex chronic condition, a diagnosis that needs specialist review, an investigation result that requires paediatric specialist interpretation, or a developmental or behavioural concern that needs structured specialist assessment requires the depth of clinical analysis that a specialist paediatrician provides.Our specialist paediatrician, registered with the Romanian College of Physicians (CMR) and the specialist Paediatric College, offers expert paediatric assessments by secure video call, for children and adolescents from birth to 18 years. Same day, from anywhere in Romania, in English and Romanian. A parent or guardian must be present throughout all consultations for children under 16.The Difference Between GP-Level and Specialist Paediatric CareGlobal Health offers two levels of paediatric care:GP-level paediatric consultation: appropriate for acute and non-urgent common childhood presentations: fever, ear infections, rashes, gastroenteritis, mild asthma, and similar conditions. Managed at primary care level by a general doctor with paediatric experience.Specialist paediatric consultation: appropriate for complex, chronic, or diagnostically uncertain presentations requiring the depth of clinical analysis, specialist knowledge, and diagnostic framework that a specialist paediatrician provides. This includes conditions that have not responded to standard management, diagnoses that need specialist review, investigation results requiring specialist interpretation, and complex multi-system presentations.If you are unsure which is appropriate, a GP-level paediatric consultation is a good starting point. Your doctor will refer to specialist paediatric assessment if indicated.Who This Service Is ForThis specialist consultation is appropriate for:Children with a complex or chronic condition requiring Consultation IncludesComprehensive specialist paediatric assessment. Your specialist paediatrician takes a detailed history: presenting concern, symptom onset and progression, relevant birth history, developmental history, family history, immunisation status, current medications, previous investigations and their results, school performance where relevant, and psychosocial context. For younger children, the consultation is conducted with the parent providing the history, with direct observation of the child on video where clinically relevant.Specialist interpretation of investigation results. If your child has had blood tests, imaging, specialist reports, or other investigations, bring these to the consultation. Your specialist paediatrician reviews all documentation in full and explains the findings clearly: what they mean for the diagnosis, what the implications are for management, and what further investigation is needed.Specialist management plan. Based on the assessment, your specialist paediatrician develops a structured, evidence-based management plan, including further investigation requests, referral for in-person specialist assessment or procedures, medication recommendations at the specialist's professional discretion, and coordination with other specialists where needed.Electronic prescription: where clinically appropriate. When clinically indicated, your specialist paediatrician issues an electronic prescription through SIPE. You present it at any pharmacy of your choice in Romania.Note: Special-regime prescriptions covering certain medications cannot be transmitted electronically under Romanian law. Your specialist advises if this applies to your child's situation.Specialist clinical documentation. Where clinically appropriate, your specialist paediatrician issues a written specialist assessment, documenting the clinical findings, diagnosis or differential diagnoses, and management recommendations, which can be shared with your child's GP, other specialists, school, or used for insurance or administrative purposes.Referral and investigation coordination. When in-person specialist assessment, subspecialty referral, or multidisciplinary input is needed, your specialist paediatrician coordinates the appropriate pathway on the same day, including referral to paediatric subspecialties where indicated.Specialist Paediatric Access in Romania: The GapRomania's specialist paediatric services are heavily concentrated in Bucharest and a small number of university hospitals, including Cluj-Napoca, Timișoara, Iași, and Craiova. Paediatric subspecialties, paediatric neurology, paediatric cardiology, paediatric endocrinology, paediatric gastroenterology, are almost exclusively available in Bucharest's dedicated children's hospitals.For families outside these centres, accessing specialist paediatric assessment involves significant travel, often hundreds of kilometres, with weeks or months of waiting time even after the journey. The impact on families of children with complex or chronic conditions is significant.Video specialist paediatric consultation closes a meaningful part of this gap, providing specialist-level paediatric assessment same day, from anywhere in Romania, without travel. When in-person specialist assessment is genuinely needed, your specialist coordinates the referral and provides the clinical documentation to make that appointment as productive as possible.Important Information Before You BookA parent or guardian must be present throughout all consultations for children under 16, in accordance with Legea nr. 272/2004For adolescents aged 16 and over, the specialist assesses capacity to consent individuallyFever in infants under 3 months is a medical emergency. schemaFaqs.question: Wann kann eine kinderärztliche Einschätzung helfen?
schemaFaqs.answer: Sie können anhaltende oder wiederkehrende Beschwerden, den Verlauf nach einer Behandlung und Fragen zur Entwicklung Ihres Kindes besprechen. Der Kinderarzt prüft die Vorgeschichte und Unterlagen und erklärt den weiteren Untersuchungsbedarf.

schemaFaqs.question: In welcher Sprache findet der Termin statt?
schemaFaqs.answer: Die für diese Leistung verfügbaren Ärzte beraten auf Rumänisch und Englisch. Prüfen Sie bei der Buchung die Sprache und den freien Termin. Eine deutsche Seite bedeutet nicht, dass der Arzt Deutsch spricht.

schemaFaqs.question: Was sollte ich bereithalten?
schemaFaqs.answer: Notieren Sie Ihre Beschwerden, seit wann sie bestehen und welche Behandlungen Sie erhalten. Halten Sie vorhandene Befunde und Arztbriefe bereit, die damit zusammenhängen.

schemaFaqs.question: Was passiert, wenn eine körperliche Untersuchung nötig ist?
schemaFaqs.answer: Wenn das Videogespräch und die Unterlagen nicht ausreichen, kann der Arzt eine Untersuchung vor Ort empfehlen. Eine Onlineberatung ersetzt keine Notfallversorgung. Rufen Sie bei einem medizinischen Notfall 112 an. Warten Sie nicht auf einen Onlinetermin.

schemaFaqs.question: Is Dr. Brînduș registered with the Romanian College of Physicians?
schemaFaqs.answer: Yes. Dr. Robert Gabriel Brînduș is registered with the Romanian College of Physicians (CMR) under number 152462. You can verify this registration on the website cmr.ro. Dr. Brînduș works as a family doctor on the Global Health Romania platform, bringing specialized training in Anesthesia and Intensive Care, with experience at the Floreasca Emergency Clinical Hospital in Bucharest, Tallaght University Hospital, and Mater Misericordiae Dublin.

schemaFaqs.question: What does Dr. Brînduș treat?
schemaFaqs.answer: Dr. Brînduș offers family medicine consultations covering acute conditions (respiratory infections, fever, flu, sore throat, urinary infections), management of chronic diseases (hypertension, diabetes, asthma, reflux, cholesterol, hypothyroidism), dermatological issues, men's and women's health, mental health (anxiety, depression, stress), preventive care, pain management, preoperative advice, prescription renewals, medical certificates, and referrals.

schemaFaqs.question: What does the ICU training bring to an online family doctor?
schemaFaqs.answer: Training in Anesthesia and Intensive Care means that Dr. Brînduș has managed some of the most complex and urgent medical situations, in operating rooms, intensive care units, and emergencies. This provides him with the ability to quickly assess the severity of a symptom, identify warning signs, and know precisely when a situation can be managed online and when it requires immediate emergency care. For a doctor consulting online, this clinical clarity is extremely valuable.

schemaFaqs.question: Can Dr. Brînduș provide advice regarding a planned surgery or postoperative recovery?
schemaFaqs.answer: Yes. His training in ICU and perioperative medicine allows him to answer questions related to preoperative preparation, explain aspects related to anesthesia, assess risks, and provide guidance regarding postoperative recovery. If you have a scheduled procedure and would like a preliminary consultation or a second opinion, Dr. Brînduș can provide an informed assessment.

schemaFaqs.question: What are Dr. Brînduș's qualifications?

He completed his residency in ICU at the Floreasca Emergency Clinical Hospital in Bucharest and continued his training as an ICU registrar at Tallaght University Hospital and Mater Misericordiae University Hospital in Dublin, Ireland. He holds the European Diploma in Anesthesia and Intensive Care (EDAIC), Part I. He is registered with the Romanian College of Physicians (CMR no. 152462).

Für einen Arzt, der online konsultiert, ist diese klinische Klarheit äußerst wertvoll.

schemaFaqs.answer: Ja. Seine Ausbildung in der Intensivmedizin und perioperativen Medizin ermöglicht es ihm, Fragen zur präoperativen Vorbereitung zu beantworten, Aspekte der Anästhesie zu erklären, Risiken zu bewerten und Anleitungen zur postoperativen Genesung zu geben. Wenn Sie eine geplante Operation haben und eine vorläufige Konsultation oder eine zweite Meinung wünschen, kann Dr. Brînduș eine fundierte Bewertung anbieten.

V současnosti pracuje v nemocnici úrovně IV (nejvyšší) v Bukurešti a byl vyškolen a pracoval v terciárních nemocnicích s vysokým objemem činnosti po celé Evropě.Dr. Brînduș absolvoval Lékařskou fakultu na Univerzitě medicíny a farmacie v Craiově a svou rezidenturu v anesteziologii a intenzivní medicíně absolvoval v Klinické nemocnici pro naléhavé případy „Floreasca“ v Bukurešti. Jeho příprava zahrnovala komplexní zkušenosti v chirurgii, léčbě bolesti a intenzivní medicíně.Následně pokračoval ve svém profesním rozvoji v Irsku, kde pracoval jako registrarský lékař v anesteziologii a intenzivní medicíně v Univerzitní nemocnici Tallaght a později v Univerzitní nemocnici Mater Misericordiae v Dublinu, kde se podílel na směnách na jednotkách intenzivní péče v komplexních a multidisciplinárních klinických prostředích.Dr. Brînduș drží Evropský diplom v anesteziologii a intenzivní medicíně (EDAIC), část I. Mluví plynně rumunsky a anglicky a má praktické znalosti španělštiny. Dr. Brînduș je známý svými silnými etickými hodnotami, analytickým myšlením a pacientsky zaměřeným přístupem. Jeho klinické zájmy zahrnují všeobecnou medicínu, léčbu bolesti a perioperační medicínu.Často kladené otázkyJe Dr. Brînduș registrován u České lékařské komory?Ano. Dr. Robert Gabriel Brînduș je registrován u České lékařské komory (ČLK) pod číslem 152462. Tuto registraci můžete zkontrolovat na webu cmr.ro. Dr. Brînduș pracuje jako praktický lékař na platformě Global Health Rumunsko a přináší specializované vzdělání v anestezii a intenzivní péči, s praxí v nemocnici Spitalul Clinic de Urgență Floreasca v Bukurešti, Spitalul Universitar Tallaght a Mater Misericordiae Dublin.Co Dr. Brînduș léčí?Dr. Brînduș poskytuje konzultace v oblasti praktického lékařství, pokrývající akutní onemocnění (respirační infekce, horečka, chřipka, bolest v krku, močové infekce), management chronických onemocnění (hypertenze, diabetes, astma, reflux, cholesterol, hypotyreóza), dermatologické problémy, zdraví mužů a žen, duševní zdraví (úzkost, deprese, stres), preventivní péči, management bolesti, perioperační poradenství, obnovení receptů, lékařské potvrzení a doporučení.Jaké výhody přináší vzdělání v oblasti anestezie a intenzivní péče praktickému lékaři online?Vzdělání v anestezii a intenzivní péči znamená, že Dr. Brînduș zvládal některé z nejkomplexnějších a nejurgentnějších lékařských situací, na operačních sálech, jednotkách intenzivní péče a pohotovostech. To mu poskytuje schopnost rychle posoudit závažnost symptomu, identifikovat varovné signály a přesně vědět, kdy může být situace řešena online a kdy vyžaduje okamžitou pohotovostní péči. Pro lékaře, který konzultuje online, je tato klinická jasnost nesmírně cenná.Může Dr. Brînduș poskytnout rady ohledně plánovaného chirurgického zákroku nebo pooperačního zotavení?Ano. Jeho vzdělání v oblasti anestezie a perioperační medicíny mu umožňuje odpovědět na otázky týkající se předoperační přípravy, vysvětlit aspekty anestezie, posoudit rizika a poskytnout pokyny ohledně pooperačního zotavení. Pokud máte naplánovaný zákrok a chcete předběžnou konzultaci nebo druhý názor, Dr. Brînduș může poskytnout informované hodnocení.Jak si rezervuji konzultaci s Dr. Brînduș?Vyberte si volný termín u Dr Robert Gabriel Brindus. Konzultace probíhají v rumunštině nebo angličtině. Jazyk a čas si ověřte při rezervaci. Dostupnost se může změnit; termín na tentýž den nelze slíbit.Jaké jsou kvalifikace Dr. Brînduș?Dr. Robert Brînduș je absolventem Lékařské fakulty UMF Craiova. title: Dr. Robert Brînduș: Medic de Familie | CMR 152462
description: Rezervați o consultație video cu Dr. Robert Brînduș, medic de familie înregistrat la CMR (nr. 152462). Formare specializată ATI · Spitalul Floreasca București · Tallaght University Hospital · EDAIC. Programare în aceeași zi.
h2: Trebuie să programați cu acest medic?
Ce spun pacienții despre medicii noștri

schemaFaqs.question: Este Dr. Brînduș înregistrat la Colegiul Medicilor din România?
schemaFaqs.answer: Da. Dr. Robert Gabriel Brînduș este înregistrat la Colegiul Medicilor din România (CMR) cu numărul 152462. Puteți verifica această înregistrare pe site-ul cmr.ro. Dr. Brînduș activează ca medic de familie pe platforma Global Health România, aducând o formare specializată în Anestezie și Terapie Intensivă, cu experiență la Spitalul Clinic de Urgență Floreasca din București, Spitalul Universitar Tallaght și Mater Misericordiae Dublin.

schemaFaqs.question: Ce tratează Dr. Brînduș?
schemaFaqs.answer: Dr. Brînduș oferă consultații de medicină de familie acoperind afecțiuni acute (infecții respiratorii, febră, gripă, dureri în gât, infecții urinare), managementul bolilor cronice (hipertensiune, diabet, astm, reflux, colesterol, hipotiroidism), probleme dermatologice, sănătatea bărbaților și femeilor, sănătate mintală (anxietate, depresie, stres), îngrijire preventivă, managementul durerii, sfaturi perioperatorii, reînnoirea prescripțiilor, adeverințe medicale și trimiteri.

schemaFaqs.question: Ce aduce pregătirea ATI unui medic de familie online?
schemaFaqs.answer: Formarea în Anestezie și Terapie Intensivă înseamnă că Dr. Brînduș a gestionat unele dintre cele mai complexe și urgente situații medicale, în săli de operații, unități de terapie intensivă și urgențe. Aceasta îi oferă capacitatea de a evalua rapid gravitatea unui simptom, de a identifica semnalele de alarmă și de a ști cu precizie când o situație poate fi gestionată online și când necesită îngrijire de urgență imediată. Pentru un medic care consultă online, această claritate clinică este extrem de valoroasă.

schemaFaqs.question: Dr. Brînduș poate oferi sfaturi legate de o intervenție chirurgicală planificată sau de recuperarea post-operatorie?
schemaFaqs.answer: Da. Formarea sa în ATI și medicină perioperatorie îi permite să răspundă întrebărilor legate de pregătirea pre-operatorie, să explice aspectele legate de anestezie, să evalueze riscuri și să ofere îndrumare privind recuperarea post-operatorie. Dacă aveți o intervenție programată și doriți o consultație preliminară sau o a doua opinie, Dr. Brînduș poate oferi o evaluare informată.

schemaFaqs.question: Cum rezerv o consultație cu Dr. Brînduș?
schemaFaqs.answer: Alegeți un interval disponibil pentru Dr Robert Gabriel Brindus. Consultațiile sunt în română sau engleză. Verificați limba și ora la rezervare. Disponibilitatea se poate schimba; nu putem promite o programare în aceeași zi.

schemaFaqs.question: Care sunt calificările Dr. Brînduș?
schemaFaqs.answer: Dr. Robert Brînduș este absolvent al Facultății de Medicină a UMF Craiova. A efectuat rezidențiatul în ATI la Spitalul Clinic de Urgență Floreasca din București și și-a continuat formarea ca medic registrator ATI la Spitalul Universitar Tallaght și Spitalul Universitar Mater Misericordiae din Dublin, Irlanda. Deține Diploma Europeană în Anestezie și Terapie Intensivă (EDAIC), Partea I. Este înregistrat la Colegiul Medicilor din România (CMR nr. 152462).

description: Dr. Robert Brînduș, médico especialista en ATI, con experiencia en Rumanía e Irlanda. Consultas online en medicina del dolor y perioperatoria.
h2: Lo que dicen los pacientes sobre nuestros médicos

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Está el Dr. Brînduș registrado en el Colegio de Médicos de Rumanía?
schemaFaqs.answer: Sí. El Dr. Robert Gabriel Brînduș está registrado en el Colegio de Médicos de Rumanía (CMR) con el número 152462. Puede verificar este registro en el sitio web cmr.ro. El Dr. Brînduș trabaja como médico de familia en la plataforma Global Health Rumanía, aportando una formación especializada en Anestesia y Terapia Intensiva, con experiencia en el Hospital Clínico de Urgencias Floreasca en Bucarest, el Hospital Universitario Tallaght y Mater Misericordiae Dublín.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Qué trata el Dr. Brînduș?
schemaFaqs.answer: El Dr. Brînduș ofrece consultas de medicina de familia cubriendo afecciones agudas (infecciones respiratorias, fiebre, gripe, dolor de garganta, infecciones urinarias), manejo de enfermedades crónicas (hipertensión, diabetes, asma, reflujo, colesterol, hipotiroidismo), problemas dermatológicos, salud de hombres y mujeres, salud mental (ansiedad, depresión, estrés), atención preventiva, manejo del dolor, consejos perioperatorios, renovación de recetas, certificados médicos y derivaciones.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Qué aporta la formación en ATI a un médico de familia en línea?
schemaFaqs.answer: La formación en Anestesia y Terapia Intensiva significa que el Dr. Brînduș ha gestionado algunas de las situaciones médicas más complejas y urgentes, en quirófanos, unidades de terapia intensiva y urgencias. Esto le proporciona la capacidad de evaluar rápidamente la gravedad de un síntoma, identificar señales de alarma y saber con precisión cuándo una situación puede ser manejada en línea y cuándo requiere atención de urgencia inmediata. Para un médico que consulta en línea, esta claridad clínica es extremadamente valiosa.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Puede el Dr. Brînduș ofrecer consejos sobre una cirugía planificada o sobre la recuperación postoperatoria?
schemaFaqs.answer: Sí. Su formación en ATI y medicina perioperatoria le permite responder preguntas relacionadas con la preparación preoperatoria, explicar aspectos relacionados con la anestesia, evaluar riesgos y ofrecer orientación sobre la recuperación postoperatoria. Si tiene una cirugía programada y desea una consulta preliminar o una segunda opinión, el Dr. Brînduș puede ofrecer una evaluación informada.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Cómo reservo una consulta con el Dr. Brînduș?
schemaFaqs.answer: Elija una cita disponible con Dr Robert Gabriel Brindus. Las consultas son en rumano o inglés. Compruebe el idioma y la hora al reservar. La disponibilidad puede cambiar; no se garantiza una cita para el mismo día.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Cuáles son las cualificaciones del Dr. Brînduș?
schemaFaqs.answer: El Dr. Robert Brînduș es graduado de la Facultad de Medicina de la UMF Craiova. Realizó la residencia en ATI en el Hospital Clínico de Urgencias Floreasca en Bucarest y continuó su formación como médico registrador de ATI en el Hospital Universitario Tallaght y el Hospital Universitario Mater Misericordiae en Dublín, Irlanda. Actualmente, ejerce en un hospital de nivel IV (máximo) en Bucarest y ha sido formado y ha trabajado en hospitales terciarios de gran volumen de actividad en toda Europa.Dr. Brînduș se graduó en la Facultad de Medicina de la Universidad de Medicina y Farmacia de Craiova y realizó su residencia en Anestesia y Terapia Intensiva en el Hospital Clínico de Urgencias „Florească” de Bucarest. Su formación incluyó una experiencia integral en cirugía, medicina del dolor y medicina de cuidados intensivos.Posteriormente, continuó su desarrollo profesional en Irlanda, donde trabajó como médico registrador en Anestesia y Terapia Intensiva en el Hospital Universitario Tallaght, y más tarde en el Hospital Universitario Mater Misericordiae de Dublín, participando en guardias en unidades de cuidados intensivos en entornos clínicos complejos y multidisciplinarios.Dr. Brînduș posee el Diploma Europeo en Anestesia y Terapia Intensiva (EDAIC), Parte I. Habla con fluidez rumano e inglés, con conocimientos prácticos de español. Dr. Brînduș es conocido por sus sólidos valores éticos, su pensamiento analítico y su enfoque centrado en el paciente. Sus intereses clínicos incluyen medicina general, medicina del dolor y medicina perioperatoria.Preguntas frecuentes¿Está el Dr. Brînduș registrado en el Colegio de Médicos de Rumanía?Sí. El Dr. Robert Gabriel Brînduș está registrado en el Colegio de Médicos de Rumanía (CMR) con el número 152462. Puede verificar este registro en el sitio web cmr.ro. El Dr. Brînduș trabaja como médico de familia en la plataforma Global Health Rumanía, aportando una formación especializada en Anestesia y Terapia Intensiva, con experiencia en el Hospital Clínico de Urgencias Floreasca en Bucarest, el Hospital Universitario Tallaght y Mater Misericordiae Dublín.¿Qué trata el Dr. Brînduș?El Dr. Brînduș ofrece consultas de medicina de familia cubriendo afecciones agudas (infecciones respiratorias, fiebre, gripe, dolor de garganta, infecciones urinarias), manejo de enfermedades crónicas (hipertensión, diabetes, asma, reflujo, colesterol, hipotiroidismo), problemas dermatológicos, salud de hombres y mujeres, salud mental (ansiedad, depresión, estrés), atención preventiva, manejo del dolor, consejos perioperatorios, renovación de recetas, certificados médicos y derivaciones.¿Qué aporta la formación en ATI a un médico de familia en línea?La formación en Anestesia y Terapia Intensiva significa que el Dr. Brînduș ha gestionado algunas de las situaciones médicas más complejas y urgentes, en quirófanos, unidades de terapia intensiva y urgencias. Esto le proporciona la capacidad de evaluar rápidamente la gravedad de un síntoma, identificar señales de alarma y saber con precisión cuándo una situación puede ser manejada en línea y cuándo requiere atención de urgencia inmediata. Para un médico que consulta en línea, esta claridad clínica es extremadamente valiosa.¿Puede el Dr. Brînduș ofrecer consejos sobre una cirugía planificada o sobre la recuperación postoperatoria?Sí. Su formación en ATI y medicina perioperatoria le permite responder preguntas relacionadas con la preparación preoperatoria, explicar aspectos relacionados con la anestesia, evaluar riesgos y ofrecer orientación sobre la recuperación postoperatoria. Si tiene una cirugía programada y desea una consulta preliminar o una segunda opinión, el Dr. Brînduș puede ofrecer una evaluación informada.¿Cómo reservo una consulta con el Dr. Brînduș?Elija una cita disponible con Dr Robert Gabriel Brindus. Las consultas son en rumano o inglés. Compruebe el idioma y la hora al reservar. La disponibilidad puede cambiar; no se garantiza una cita para el mismo día.¿Cuáles son las cualificaciones del Dr. Brînduș?El Dr. Robert Brînduș es graduado de la Facultad de Medicina de la UMF Craiova. Realizó la residencia en ATI en el Hospital Clínico de Urgencias Floreasca en Bucarest y continuó su formación como médico registrador de ATI en el Hospital Universitario Tallaght y el Hospital Universitario Mater Misericordiae en Dublín, Irlanda. Posee el Diploma Europeo en Anestesia y Terapia Intensiva (EDAIC), Parte I. title: Dr. Alexandra Palaga: Pediatru Specialist | CMR 159625
description: Rezervați o consultație video cu Dr. Alexandra Palaga, pediatru specialist înregistrat la CMR (nr. 159625). UMF Carol Davila · Urgențe pediatrice · Gastroenterologie și nutriție · Boală celiacă · ESPGHAN. Programare în aceeași zi.
h2: Trebuie să programați cu acest medic?
Ce spun pacienții despre medicii noștri

schemaFaqs.question: Este Dr. Palaga înregistrată la Colegiul Medicilor din România?
schemaFaqs.answer: Da. Dr. Alexandra Palaga este înregistrată la Colegiul Medicilor din România (CMR) cu numărul 159625. Puteți verifica această înregistrare pe site-ul cmr.ro. Dr. Palaga este medic specialist pediatru certificat de Ministerul Sănătății din România, absolventă a UMF Carol Davila și membră trainee ESPGHAN.

schemaFaqs.question: Când poate fi utilă opinia unui pediatru?
schemaFaqs.answer: Puteți discuta simptome persistente sau recurente, evoluția după un tratament și întrebări despre dezvoltarea copilului. Pediatrul revizuiește istoricul și documentele disponibile și explică dacă este nevoie de investigații sau examinare fizică. Medicul vă poate recomanda evaluare în persoană dacă discuția video și documentele nu sunt suficiente. Consultația online nu înlocuiește îngrijirea de urgență. Într-o urgență medicală, sunați la 112. Nu așteptați o programare online.

schemaFaqs.question: Are Dr. Palaga expertiză specială în boala celiacă și gastroenterologie pediatrică?
schemaFaqs.answer: Da. Dr. Palaga a activat ca investigator de cercetare la Centrul de Management al Bolii Celiace din cadrul Institutului Național pentru Sănătatea Mamei și Copilului „Alessandrescu-Rusescu", centrul de referință național pentru această afecțiune. Lucrările sale privind strategiile nutriționale și dieta fără gluten la copii au fost publicate în Frontiers in Pediatrics. Este membră trainee ESPGHAN și a prezentat cercetări la conferințe internaționale ESPGHAN. Pentru familiile cu copii cu suspiciune de boală celiacă, intoleranță alimentară sau probleme digestive cronice, această expertiză este rar disponibilă într-o consultație online.

schemaFaqs.question: Pot rezerva o consultație pediatrică fără trimitere de la medicul de familie?
schemaFaqs.answer: Da. Prin Global Health România puteți rezerva direct o consultație cu Dr. Palaga fără trimitere de la medicul de familie sau pediatrul curent. Dacă aveți scrisori medicale anterioare, rezultate analize sau investigații ale copilului, vă rugăm să le transmiteți înainte de consultație. Nu sunt obligatorii pentru rezervare, dar ajută la o evaluare mai precisă.

schemaFaqs.question: Cum rezerv o consultație cu Dr. Palaga?
schemaFaqs.answer: Alegeți un interval disponibil pentru Dr Alexandra Palaga. Consultațiile sunt în română sau engleză. Verificați limba și ora la rezervare. Disponibilitatea se poate schimba; nu putem promite o programare în aceeași zi.

schemaFaqs.question: Care sunt calificările și experiența de cercetare ale Dr. Palaga?
schemaFaqs.answer: Dr. Alexandra Palaga este absolventă a UMF Carol Davila din București și a efectuat rezidențiatul în Pediatrie la Spitalul Clinic de Urgență pentru Copii „Sf. Ioan" din Galați și la Spitalul Clinic de Urgență „Sf. Ioan" din București. A activat ca investigator de cercetare la INSMCA „Alessandrescu-Rusescu" și a publicat în Frontiers in Pediatrics. Este membră trainee ESPGHAN și speaker la congrese internaționale ESPGHAN și Academia Europeană a Societăților de Pediatrie. Este înregistrată la CMR (nr. 159625).

schemaFaqs.question: Is Dr. Palaga registered with the Romanian College of Physicians?
schemaFaqs.answer: Yes. Dr. Alexandra Palaga is registered with the Romanian College of Physicians (CMR) under number 159625. You can verify this registration on the website cmr.ro. Dr. Palaga is a pediatric specialist certified by the Ministry of Health of Romania, a graduate of UMF Carol Davila, and a trainee member of ESPGHAN.

schemaFaqs.question: When might a pediatrician’s opinion help?
schemaFaqs.answer: You can discuss persistent or recurring symptoms, progress after treatment and questions about your child’s development. The pediatrician reviews the history and available records, then explains whether tests or a physical examination are needed. The doctor may recommend an in-person assessment if the video discussion and records are not enough. An online consultation does not replace emergency care. For a medical emergency, call 112. Do not wait for an online appointment.

schemaFaqs.question: Does Dr. Palaga have special expertise in celiac disease and pediatric gastroenterology?
schemaFaqs.answer: Yes. Dr. Palaga has worked as a research investigator at the Celiac Disease Management Center within the National Institute for Mother and Child Health "Alessandrescu-Rusescu", the national reference center for this condition. Her work on nutritional strategies and gluten-free diets in children has been published in Frontiers in Pediatrics. She is a trainee member of ESPGHAN and has presented research at international ESPGHAN conferences. For families with children suspected of having celiac disease, food intolerance, or chronic digestive issues, this expertise is rarely available in an online consultation.

schemaFaqs.question: Can I book a pediatric consultation without a referral from my family doctor?
schemaFaqs.answer: Yes. Through Global Health Romania, you can directly book a consultation with Dr. Palaga without a referral from your family doctor or current pediatrician. If you have previous medical letters, test results, or investigations for your child, please send them before the consultation. They are not mandatory for booking, but they help with a more accurate assessment.

schemaFaqs.answer: Choose an available appointment with Dr Alexandra Palaga. Consultations are in Romanian or English. Check the language and time when booking. Availability can change; a same-day appointment cannot be promised.

Mezi její přínosy patří:Odbornice na celiakii: působila jako výzkumná pracovnice a analytička v Centru pro management celiakie při Národním institutu pro zdraví matky a dítěte „Alessandrescu-Rusescu“.Mezinárodní přispěvatelka: častá řečnice a prezentující na mezinárodních fórech, včetně ESPGHAN (Evropská společnost pro dětskou gastroenterologii, hepatologii a výživu) a Evropské akademie pediatrických společností.Publikovaná výzkumnice: její práce o dopadu nutričních strategií a bezlepkových diet na kvalitu života dětí byly publikovány v prestižních časopisech, jako je Frontiers in Pediatrics.Vzdělání a profesní členstvíLékařský diplom: Univerzita lékařství a farmacie „Carol Davila“, Bukurešť.Odborná certifikace: Lékařka specialistka v pediatrii certifikovaná Ministerstvem zdravotnictví Rumunska.Členství: trainee členka ESPGHAN a aktivní členka Rumunské lékařské komory.Další vzdělávání: Dr. Palaga má pokročilé certifikace v pediatrické výživě, detekci pediatrické malnutrice a dědičných metabolických poruchách.Dr. Palaga spojuje klinické dovednosti s empatickým přístupem založeným na vědeckých důkazech, aby zajistila každému malému pacientovi nejvyšší standardy péče.Často kladené otázkyJe Dr. Palaga registrována u Colegiul Medicilor din România?Ano. Dr. Alexandra Palaga je registrována u Colegiul Medicilor din România (CMR) s číslem 159625. Tuto registraci můžete zkontrolovat na webových stránkách cmr.ro. Dr. Palaga je specialistka na pediatrii certifikovaná Ministerstvem zdravotnictví Rumunska, absolventka UMF Carol Davila a trainee členka ESPGHAN.Kdy může pomoci názor pediatra?Můžete probrat přetrvávající či opakované příznaky, průběh po léčbě a otázky k vývoji dítěte. Pediatr projde anamnézu a dostupné zprávy a vysvětlí, zda je potřeba vyšetření nebo osobní prohlídka. Pokud videohovor a zdravotní dokumentace nestačí, lékař může doporučit osobní vyšetření. Online konzultace nenahrazuje neodkladnou péči. V případě zdravotní nouze volejte 112. Nečekejte na online termín.Má Dr. Palaga zvláštní odborné znalosti v oblasti celiakie a pediatrické gastroenterologie?Ano. Dr. Palaga pracovala jako výzkumná investigator na Centru pro management celiakie v rámci Národního institutu pro zdraví matky a dítěte „Alessandrescu-Rusescu", národním referenčním centru pro tuto nemoc. Její práce týkající se nutričních strategií a bezlepkové diety u dětí byly publikovány v časopise Frontiers in Pediatrics. Je trainee členkou ESPGHAN a prezentovala výzkum na mezinárodních konferencích ESPGHAN. Pro rodiny s dětmi s podezřením na celiakii, potravinovou intoleranci nebo chronické trávicí problémy je tato odborná znalost vzácně dostupná v online konzultaci.Mohu si rezervovat pediatrickou konzultaci bez doporučení od praktického lékaře?Ano. Prostřednictvím Global Health Rumunsko si můžete přímo rezervovat konzultaci s Dr. Palaga bez doporučení od praktického lékaře nebo aktuálního pediatra. Pokud máte předchozí lékařské zprávy, výsledky testů nebo vyšetření dítěte, prosím, zašlete je před konzultací. Nejsou povinné pro rezervaci, ale pomáhají k přesnějšímu hodnocení.Jak si rezervuji konzultaci s Dr. Palaga?Vyberte si volný termín u Dr Alexandra Palaga. Konzultace probíhají v rumunštině nebo angličtině. Jazyk a čas si ověřte při rezervaci. Dostupnost se může změnit; termín na tentýž den nelze slíbit.Jaké jsou kvalifikace a výzkumné zkušenosti Dr. Palaga?Dr. Alexandra Palaga je absolventka UMF Carol Davila v Bukurešti a absolvovala rezidenční program v pediatrii na Klinice urgentní medicíny pro děti „Sf. Ioan" v Galați a na Klinice urgentní medicíny „Sf. Ioan" v Bukurešti. Pracovala jako výzkumná investigator na INSMCA „Alessandrescu-Rusescu" a publikovala v časopise Frontiers in Pediatrics. Je trainee členkou ESPGHAN a přednášející na mezinárodních kongresech ESPGHAN a Evropské akademie pediatrických společností. Náš pediatr s licencí CMR nabízí videokonzultace pro případy, které vyžadují důkladnou klinickou analýzu.15 minZobrazit podrobnosti o službě: Online konzultace s pediatremVybrat termín: Online konzultace s pediatremMedical disclaimer. title: Dr Robert Gabriel Brindus - Anestesista | Global Health
description: Dr. Robert Brînduș, médico especialista em ATI, experiência na Roménia e na Irlanda. Consultas online em medicina da dor e perioperatória.
h2: Precisa de agendar com este médico?
O que os pacientes dizem sobre os nossos médicos

schemaFaqs.question: Este o Dr. Brînduș registado no Colegiul Medicilor din România?
schemaFaqs.answer: Sim. O Dr. Robert Gabriel Brînduș está registado na Ordem dos Médicos da Roménia (CMR) com o número 152462. Pode verificar este registo no site cmr.ro. O Dr. Brînduș atua como médico de família na plataforma Global Health Roménia, trazendo uma formação especializada em Anestesia e Terapia Intensiva, com experiência no Hospital Clínico de Urgência Floreasca em Bucareste, Hospital Universitário Tallaght e Mater Misericordiae Dublin.

schemaFaqs.question: O que trata o Dr. Brînduș?
schemaFaqs.answer: O Dr. Brînduș oferece consultas de medicina de família cobrindo condições agudas (infeções respiratórias, febre, gripe, dores de garganta, infeções urinárias), gestão de doenças crónicas (hipertensão, diabetes, asma, refluxo, colesterol, hipotiroidismo), problemas dermatológicos, saúde dos homens e das mulheres, saúde mental (ansiedade, depressão, stress), cuidados preventivos, gestão da dor, conselhos perioperatórios, renovação de prescrições, atestados médicos e encaminhamentos.

schemaFaqs.question: O que traz a formação em ATI a um médico de família online?
schemaFaqs.answer: A formação em Anestesia e Terapia Intensiva significa que o Dr. Brînduș geriu algumas das situações médicas mais complexas e urgentes, em salas de operações, unidades de terapia intensiva e urgências. Isso proporciona-lhe a capacidade de avaliar rapidamente a gravidade de um sintoma, identificar sinais de alarme e saber com precisão quando uma situação pode ser gerida online e quando necessita de cuidados de urgência imediata. Para um médico que consulta online, esta clareza clínica é extremamente valiosa.

schemaFaqs.question: O Dr. Brînduș pode oferecer conselhos relacionados com uma cirurgia planeada ou com a recuperação pós-operatória?
schemaFaqs.answer: Sim. A sua formação em ATI e medicina perioperatória permite-lhe responder a perguntas relacionadas com a preparação pré-operatória, explicar aspectos relacionados com a anestesia, avaliar riscos e oferecer orientação sobre a recuperação pós-operatória. Se tiver uma cirurgia programada e desejar uma consulta preliminar ou uma segunda opinião, o Dr. Brînduș pode fornecer uma avaliação informada.

schemaFaqs.question: Como posso marcar uma consulta com o Dr. Brînduș?
schemaFaqs.answer: Escolha um horário disponível com Dr Robert Gabriel Brindus. As consultas são em romeno ou inglês. Confirme a língua e a hora ao marcar. A disponibilidade pode mudar; não se pode garantir uma consulta no próprio dia.

schemaFaqs.question: Quais são as qualificações do Dr. Brînduș?
schemaFaqs.answer: O Dr. Robert Brînduș é graduado pela Faculdade de Medicina da UMF Craiova. Realizou a sua residência em ATI no Hospital Clínico de Urgência Floreasca em Bucareste e continuou a sua formação como médico assistente de ATI no Hospital Universitário Tallaght e no Hospital Universitário Mater Misericordiae em Dublin, Irlanda. Possui o Diploma Europeu em Anestesia e Terapia Intensiva (EDAIC), Parte I. Está registado na Ordem dos Médicos da Roménia (CMR nº 152462).

schemaFaqs.question: Ist Dr. Palaga beim Kolleg der Ärzte in Rumänien registriert?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ja. Dr. Alexandra Palaga ist beim Kolleg der Ärzte in Rumänien (CMR) unter der Nummer 159625 registriert. Sie können diese Registrierung auf der Website cmr.ro überprüfen. Dr. Palaga ist Fachärztin für Pädiatrie, zertifiziert vom Ministerium für Gesundheit in Rumänien, Absolventin der UMF Carol Davila und Trainee-Mitglied der ESPGHAN.

schemaFaqs.question: Wann kann eine kinderärztliche Einschätzung helfen?
schemaFaqs.answer: Sie können anhaltende oder wiederkehrende Beschwerden, den Verlauf nach einer Behandlung und Fragen zur Entwicklung Ihres Kindes besprechen. Der Kinderarzt prüft die Vorgeschichte und Unterlagen und erklärt den weiteren Untersuchungsbedarf. Wenn das Videogespräch und die Unterlagen nicht ausreichen, kann der Arzt eine Untersuchung vor Ort empfehlen. Eine Onlineberatung ersetzt keine Notfallversorgung. Rufen Sie bei einem medizinischen Notfall 112 an. Warten Sie nicht auf einen Onlinetermin.

schemaFaqs.question: Hat Dr. Palaga spezielle Expertise in Zöliakie und pädiatrischer Gastroenterologie?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ja. Dr. Palaga war als Forschungsinvestigator am Zentrum für das Management der Zöliakie im Nationalen Institut für Gesundheit von Mutter und Kind „Alessandrescu-Rusescu" tätig, dem nationalen Referenzzentrum für diese Erkrankung. Ihre Arbeiten zu Ernährungsstrategien und glutenfreier Ernährung bei Kindern wurden in Frontiers in Pediatrics veröffentlicht. Sie ist Trainee-Mitglied der ESPGHAN und hat Forschungsergebnisse auf internationalen ESPGHAN-Konferenzen präsentiert. Für Familien mit Kindern, bei denen der Verdacht auf Zöliakie, Nahrungsmittelunverträglichkeit oder chronische Verdauungsprobleme besteht, ist diese Expertise in einer Online-Beratung selten verfügbar.

schemaFaqs.question: Kann ich eine pädiatrische Beratung ohne Überweisung vom Hausarzt buchen?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ja. Über Global Health Rumänien können Sie direkt einen Termin mit Dr. Palaga ohne Überweisung vom Hausarzt oder aktuellen Kinderarzt buchen. Wenn Sie frühere medizinische Schreiben, Untersuchungsergebnisse oder Untersuchungen des Kindes haben, senden Sie diese bitte vor der Beratung zu. Sie sind nicht obligatorisch für die Buchung, helfen jedoch bei einer genaueren Bewertung.

schemaFaqs.question: Wie buche ich eine Beratung mit Dr. Palaga?
schemaFaqs.answer: Wählen Sie einen verfügbaren Termin bei Dr Alexandra Palaga. Die Beratung erfolgt auf Rumänisch oder Englisch. Prüfen Sie Sprache und Uhrzeit bei der Buchung. Die Verfügbarkeit kann sich ändern; ein Termin am selben Tag lässt sich nicht zusagen.

title: Dr Andreea Lorena Bica - Neurolog | Global Health
description: Dr. Andreea-Lorena Bica, specialista neurolog s praxí v cévní mozkové příhodě, epilepsii a neurodegenerativních onemocněních. Domluvte si online konzultaci.
h2: Potřebujete se domluvit s tímto lékařem?
Co pacienti říkají o našich lékařích

schemaFaqs.question: Je Dr. Bica registrována u Colegiul Medicilor din România?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ano. Dr. Andreea-Lorena Bica je registrována u Colegiul Medicilor din România (CMR) s číslem 147502. Tuto registraci můžete ověřit na stránkách cmr.ro. Dr. Bica je specialistka v neurologii, s výcvikem na Spitalul Universitar de Urgență Elias v Bukurešti a podílela se jako spoluautorka na prezentacích na Kongresu Evropské akademie neurologie (EAN).

schemaFaqs.question: Jaké neurologické poruchy hodnotí Dr. Bica online?
schemaFaqs.answer: Dr. Bica nabízí online neurologické konzultace pro: CMP a cerebrovaskulární onemocnění (sekundární hodnocení, prevence, interpretace vyšetření), epilepsii (hodnocení a úprava léčby), neurodegenerativní onemocnění (Parkinson, demence, roztroušená skleróza), bolesti hlavy a migrénu, periferní neuropatie (znecitlivění, brnění, slabost), poruchy pohybu, rozhraní neurologie-psychiatrie, druhý názor na diagnózy nebo výsledky MRI/CT a interpretaci neurologických vyšetření.

schemaFaqs.question: Potřebuji doporučení od praktického lékaře k online konzultaci s neurologem?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ne. Přes Global Health Rumunsko si můžete přímo rezervovat konzultaci s Dr. Bica bez doporučení od praktického lékaře. Pokud máte předchozí lékařské zprávy, výsledky MRI, EEG nebo jiná vyšetření, prosím, zašlete je před konzultací. Nejsou povinné pro rezervaci, ale pomohou k přesnějšímu hodnocení.

schemaFaqs.question: Může Dr. Bica vysvětlit výsledky mozkové MRI nebo jiných neurologických vyšetření?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ano. Dr. Bica má specializovaný výcvik v neuroimagingu a neuroradiologii a může interpretovat a vysvětlit výsledky mozkové a páteřní MRI, CT, EEG a dalších neurologických vyšetření jako součást online konzultace. Pokud zašlete radiologickou zprávu nebo lékařský dopis před schůzkou, Dr. Bica bude moci poskytnout podrobnější hodnocení.

schemaFaqs.question: Jak si rezervuji konzultaci s Dr. Bica?
schemaFaqs.answer: Vyberte si volný termín u Dr Andreea Lorena Bica. Konzultace probíhají v rumunštině nebo angličtině. Jazyk a čas si ověřte při rezervaci. Dostupnost se může změnit; termín na tentýž den nelze slíbit.

schemaFaqs.question: Jaké jsou kvalifikace Dr. Bica?
schemaFaqs.answer: Dr. Andreea-Lorena Bica je absolventkou Lékařské fakulty Univerzity medicíny a farmacie v Craiově a absolvovala rezidenční program v neurologii na Spitalul Universitar de Urgență Elias v Bukurešti. Dr. Bica este medic specialist în Neurologie, cu formare la Spitalul Universitar de Urgență Elias din București și a contribuit ca și co-autor la prezentări la Congresul Academiei Europene de Neurologie (EAN).

schemaFaqs.question: Ce afecțiuni neurologice evaluează Dr. Bica online?

schemaFaqs.question: Am nevoie de trimitere de la medicul de familie pentru a consulta un neurolog online?
schemaFaqs.answer: Nu. Prin Global Health România puteți rezerva direct o consultație cu Dr. Bica fără trimitere de la medicul de familie. Dacă aveți scrisori medicale anterioare, rezultate RMN, EEG sau alte investigații, vă rugăm să le transmiteți înainte de consultație. Acestea nu sunt obligatorii pentru rezervare, dar ajută la o evaluare mai precisă.

schemaFaqs.question: Poate Dr. Bica explica rezultatele unui RMN cerebral sau alte investigații neurologice?
schemaFaqs.answer: Da. Dr. Bica are formare specializată în neuroimagistică și neuroradiologie și poate interpreta și explica rezultatele RMN cerebral și spinal, CT, EEG și alte investigații neurologice ca parte a consultației online. Dacă transmiteți raportul radiologic sau scrisoarea medicală înainte de programare, Dr. Bica va putea oferi o evaluare mai detaliată.

schemaFaqs.question: Cum rezerv o consultație cu Dr. Bica?
schemaFaqs.answer: Alegeți un interval disponibil pentru Dr Andreea Lorena Bica. Consultațiile sunt în română sau engleză. Verificați limba și ora la rezervare. Disponibilitatea se poate schimba; nu putem promite o programare în aceeași zi.

schemaFaqs.question: Ist Dr. Bica beim Kolleg der Ärzte in Rumänien registriert?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ja. Dr. Andreea-Lorena Bica ist beim Kolleg der Ärzte in Rumänien (CMR) mit der Nummer 147502 registriert. Sie können diese Registrierung auf der Website cmr.ro überprüfen. Dr. Bica ist Fachärztin für Neurologie, mit Ausbildung am Universitätsnotfallkrankenhaus Elias in Bukarest, und hat als Co-Autorin zu Präsentationen beim Kongress der Europäischen Akademie für Neurologie (EAN) beigetragen.

schemaFaqs.question: Welche neurologischen Erkrankungen bewertet Dr. Bica online?
schemaFaqs.answer: Dr. Bica bietet online neurologische Konsultationen für: Schlaganfall und zerebrovaskuläre Erkrankungen (sekundäre Bewertung, Prävention, Interpretation von Untersuchungen), Epilepsie (Bewertung und Anpassung der Behandlung), neurodegenerative Erkrankungen (Parkinson, Demenz, Multiple Sklerose), Kopfschmerzen und Migräne, periphere Neuropathien (Taubheit, Kribbeln, Schwäche), Bewegungsstörungen, die Schnittstelle Neurologie-Psychiatrie, eine zweite Meinung zu Diagnosen oder MRT/CT-Ergebnissen sowie die Interpretation neurologischer Untersuchungen an.

schemaFaqs.question: Benötige ich eine Überweisung vom Hausarzt, um online einen Neurologen zu konsultieren?
schemaFaqs.answer: Nein. Über Global Health Rumänien können Sie direkt einen Termin bei Dr. Bica ohne Überweisung vom Hausarzt buchen. Wenn Sie frühere medizinische Berichte, MRT-, EEG- oder andere Untersuchungsergebnisse haben, senden Sie diese bitte vor der Konsultation zu. Sie sind nicht obligatorisch für die Buchung, helfen jedoch bei einer genaueren Bewertung.

schemaFaqs.question: Kann Dr. Bica die Ergebnisse eines Gehirn-MRT oder anderer neurologischer Untersuchungen erklären?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ja. Dr. Bica hat eine spezialisierte Ausbildung in Neuroimaging und Neuroradiologie und kann die Ergebnisse von Gehirn- und Rückenmark-MRT, CT, EEG und anderen neurologischen Untersuchungen im Rahmen der Online-Konsultation interpretieren und erklären. Wenn Sie den radiologischen Bericht oder das medizinische Schreiben vor dem Termin übermitteln, kann Dr. Bica eine detailliertere Bewertung anbieten.

schemaFaqs.question: Wie buche ich eine Konsultation mit Dr. Bica?
